narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think any fold through the centre will make the halves overlap. It cuts the square in two equal halves.
<bookmark mark='tilt'/>Try a fold through the centre that is tilted a little between two of the known folds.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Equal looking halves are not enough, so let us fold the paper and watch the corners.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A fold counts only when the two halves overlap exactly, not when they merely look equal.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Tanvi folds a paper letter E. Does any fold besides across the middle work?
